blocks.text: Shaina Magdayao and JC de Vera are set to bring Francisco Balagtas’ literary classic “Florante at Laura” to the big screen in a new film adaptation directed by Alvin Yapan. Titled “Ang Florante at Laura ni Balagtas,” the film will introduce the 19th-century Filipino literary work to a new generation. The film’s official trailer is scheduled to launch on Oct. 10, at 1 p.m. at Booth F14 of the Asian Contents & Film Market in Busan, South Korea.
